target.statement: Logistic Regression AUC-ROC = 0.8411 on the held-out test set (n=1,409) of the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark, with SMOTE applied to the training partition only
target.dataset: IBM Telco Customer Churn (7,043 records, 19 features)

compute.basis: Small public CSV (7k rows); preprocessing + SMOTE + logistic regression + 4 tree models on 8 CPU cores takes seconds to a couple of minutes per run, dominated by pip installs and dataset download; exact AUC may differ slightly from the reported 0.8411 due to unspecified random seed and library versions.

blockers: No code or repository linked in the paper; pipeline must be re-implemented from the methodology text
Exact reproduction of 0.8411 is seed/version sensitive (SMOTE seed, train-test split seed, sklearn version) so the number may land within ~0.005 rather than exactly
Paper mentions a synthetic fallback generator but all reported results use the real IBM dataset, which is freely downloadable
title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Customer Churn Prediction in Telecommunications: A Framework for CRM Integration
